question: List the forename and surname of drivers born between 1980 and 1985 who set a fastest lap time that ranked in the top 10 of any race, and whose fastest lap time (converted to seconds) is faster than the average fastest lap time across all such top-10 laps.

        r.XCL_074 AS race_id,

        CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS lap_time_seconds,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.XCL_074 ORDER BY 
            (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
            CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL)

    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_top10 AS (

    FROM top10_laps
    WHERE lap_rank <= 10
)

FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN top10_laps t ON d.XCL_034 = t.driver_id
CROSS JOIN avg_top10 a
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'

WITH top10_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
        r.XCL_074 AS race_id,
        (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS lap_time_seconds,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.XCL_074 ORDER BY 
            (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
            CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
        ) AS lap_rank
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_top10 AS (
    SELECT AVG(lap_time_seconds) AS avg_top10_lap_time
    FROM top10_laps
    WHERE lap_rank <= 10
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN top10_laps t ON d.XCL_034 = t.driver_id
CROSS JOIN avg_top10 a
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
  AND t.lap_rank <= 10
  AND t.lap_time_seconds < a.avg_top10_lap_time
